players.name: Rowan Vale
players.purpose: Moves the defense, then moves the puck.
methods: Shows the wall; finds the middle.
Changes the shooting and passing lane.
Feeds the center before pressure arrives.
players.assignment: D1 · PP1 point. Activate when the weak side covers.
players.links: Partner holds the middle; center offers the low outlet.
players.limitations: Less effective shooting through heavy traffic.
players.distinctive: Changes the angle before the defense resets.
questions: Does the first forechecker take away the middle?

players.name: Mika North
players.purpose: Stays available for the next threat.
methods: Finds the next threat after first contact.
Leaves a clean puck for the retrieval.
players.assignment: Starter. Set depth to the puck; delay before lateral commitment.
players.links: Near defender retrieves the leave; far defender provides the reverse.
players.limitations: Long outlets under pressure are less reliable.
players.distinctive: Recovers into the next play with minimal extra movement.
questions: Is the receiver visible before the exchange?
Can the defense clear the second shot?
